newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto EPS view cut.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst Mark Wiltamuth said his firm cut its 1997 earnings estimate for Monsanto by $0.15 a share to $1.65 a share due to expected dilution from a planned Monsanto acquisition.
-- Earlier, Monsanto said it plans to buy Holden's Foundation Seeds Inc, Corn States Hybrid Service and Corn States International for up to $1.02 billion.
-- NatWest has an accumulate rating on the stock. Shares were up 1-1/2 at 41-1/8.
-- "It's a strategic positive for Monsanto," said Wiltamuth.

-- The analyst said the value of Holden's for Monsanto is based on what that business has the potential to become when Holden's germplasm -- or parent seed stock -- is coupled with Monsanto's genetic developments for crops.
-- Monsanto may eventually take some write-down charges related to the Holden's acquisition, the analyst said.
